data.name: Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet
data.detailed_description:
Join Nelly in this point and click adventure, and rescue birds hypnotised by the villainous Baron Widebeard. Meet a hilarious cast of characters including Tom Baker (Dr Who) and explore a hand-drawn world created by award-winning comedian Alasdair Beckett-King.

  • Race aristocrats for fun and profit.
  • Commandeer an ancient airship.
  • Enter the mind of a monkey wizard.
  • Borrow moonshine from a surly Viking.
  • Wantonly misuse the word ‘borrow’.

What is Baron Widebeard planning? Can he be stopped? In what way is a frozen volcano involved?

To answer these questions comes Nelly Cootalot: pirate heroine and defender of endangered and adorable creatures. Nelly’s journey will take her from Port Rubicund in the South Seas to the lonely isle of Gloomholm in the icy north. She’ll encounter outlandish characters and face perplexing challenges in her quest for the Treasure of the Seventh Sea.


  • Full Voice-Acting in English & German.
  • A script that will amuse and delight whether you are 9, 19 or 90. (But ONLY those ages.)
  • Art & Animation in glorious High Definition.
  • Puzzles that will tax the world's greatest minds, if they're having an off-day.
  • Over 45 Unique Characters & 35 Locations.
  • Quaint British spellings = extra letters for free.


  • "The puzzles are as perfect as possible."
    - Just Adventure
  • "overflowing with charm and heart"
    Score 4/5 - Adventure Gamers
  • "I had a lot of fun with Nelly Cootalot, and I recommend it for anyone who loves point-and-click adventures, birds, and/or pirates.."
    Score A - Nerdy but Flirty
  • "absolutely hilarious"
    Score 9/10 - Gamespew
  • "...with some beautiful art, an engaging story, some fun gameplay and snappy dialogue, Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet is a nice little gem."
    9.1/10 - Geeknifty
  • "It has obviously been influenced by the Monkey Island series, but without being a carbon copy. If you are a fan of the genre, then The Fowl Fleet should definitely be on your wishlist."
    8.3 - Gameramble
  • "A joy to play through from start to finish... easily one of the most enjoyable adventures of 2016."
    8/10 - cubed3
  • "Outstanding puzzle design"
    87% - adventurecorner
  • "An amazing adventure game. Its story has surprising depth, the characters are lovable, the puzzles are great fun and it wraps it all up in a layer of fantastic humour!"
    4.5/5 - The Mental Attic
  • "Lovingly crafted and amounts to a very relaxing and enjoyable point ‘n click experience."
    7 very good - Techraptor
  • "A delightful point-and-click romp of swashing and buckling. In short, it’ll straight up charm your knickers off."
    Buy it! - vgblogger
  • "Go play Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet. I highly recommend it."
    - @SQHistorian
  • "Tom Baker is in it, which is important."
    - PC Gamer

reviews.review:
Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet is a delightful point-and-click adventure that captures the charm of classic adventure gaming through imaginative storytelling, amusing dialogue, and beautifully illustrated environments. Developed by Alasdair Beckett-King and Application Systems Heidelberg, and published by Application Systems Heidelberg, the game delivers a whimsical pirate adventure filled with unusual characters, creative puzzles, and distinctly British humor. Its combination of traditional gameplay mechanics and lighthearted storytelling makes it particularly appealing to players who appreciate thoughtful exploration rather than action-oriented challenges.

The story follows Nelly Cootalot, a determined pirate heroine investigating the suspicious activities of Baron Widebeard, a villain who has been hypnotizing birds for his mysterious purposes. Her mission to protect these innocent creatures gradually develops into an elaborate adventure involving the legendary Treasure of the Seventh Sea. Along the way, players explore exotic destinations, encounter eccentric personalities, and uncover increasingly bizarre situations. The narrative successfully combines mystery, comedy, and adventure while maintaining a cheerful atmosphere that encourages curiosity.

One of the game's strongest qualities is its writing. Conversations are filled with clever wordplay, humorous observations, and absurd situations that give the adventure a memorable personality. Nelly serves as an engaging protagonist whose compassion and determination contrast effectively with the strange individuals surrounding her. The supporting cast features more than 45 characters, each contributing something distinctive to the experience. Although the frequent puns and exaggerated comedy might not appeal to everyone, the consistent writing style gives the adventure an unmistakable identity.

Gameplay revolves around exploring environments, collecting objects, interacting with characters, and solving puzzles. The mechanics follow traditional point-and-click conventions, emphasizing observation and logical experimentation rather than quick reflexes. Players must carefully examine their surroundings, identify useful clues, and determine how different objects and conversations connect. The puzzles offer a satisfying mixture of straightforward challenges and unconventional solutions, although certain situations require the peculiar reasoning commonly associated with classic adventure games.

The adventure becomes particularly entertaining through its imaginative scenarios. Players can participate in unusual competitions, commandeer an ancient airship, explore the mind of a monkey wizard, and negotiate with an unfriendly Viking. These encounters demonstrate the game's creativity while ensuring that puzzle-solving rarely feels disconnected from its humorous world. Occasionally, progress may slow when a solution is insufficiently obvious, but the absence of demanding combat or strict time limits allows players to approach challenges comfortably.

Visually, the game features colorful hand-drawn artwork complemented by expressive character designs and charming animations. More than 35 locations provide considerable environmental variety, ranging from tropical settlements to isolated northern landscapes. Each area contains distinctive scenery and interactive details that encourage exploration. The illustrated presentation resembles an animated storybook, creating an inviting atmosphere that suits the game's playful narrative. Although the animation is relatively modest, the cohesive artistic direction remains one of its most attractive qualities.

Voice acting further enhances the presentation, with complete English and German performances bringing additional personality to the dialogue. The inclusion of Tom Baker adds recognizable talent to an already entertaining cast. Vocal delivery strengthens the comedic timing and makes conversations more enjoyable, particularly during encounters with eccentric supporting characters. The soundtrack and environmental audio complement the atmosphere without distracting from the storytelling. Multiple language options also make the adventure accessible to a broader audience.

Despite its considerable charm, the experience has limitations. Players expecting intense action, extensive customization, or complicated progression systems may find its traditional adventure structure restrictive. Some puzzles depend on unusual combinations or humorous logic, occasionally interrupting the narrative's momentum. Replayability is also relatively limited because discovering puzzle solutions and experiencing the story constitute the main attractions. Nevertheless, Steam achievements provide additional objectives for completionists.

Steam Deck compatibility is another advantage. The game has an official Steam Deck Verified classification, indicating that it meets Valve's compatibility requirements for handheld play. Controller support, readable interface elements, and touchscreen interaction make navigating its environments convenient. Its relaxed gameplay structure is particularly suitable for portable sessions, allowing players to explore, solve puzzles, and enjoy conversations without demanding precise reactions.

Overall, Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet succeeds by embracing the qualities that make traditional point-and-click adventures enjoyable. Its entertaining characters, imaginative situations, attractive illustrations, and humorous writing create a memorable experience that prioritizes personality over technical complexity. While occasional obscure puzzles and limited replay value prevent it from reaching perfection, its creativity and accessibility make it an excellent recommendation for adventure enthusiasts.

A charming, humorous, and creatively designed pirate adventure that delivers enjoyable puzzles, memorable characters, and delightful storytelling.

Rating: 8/10
